meta.description: Sort, merge, collate, and verify alignment-file order with samtools and pysam. Use when preparing BAM files for indexing, variant calling, or paired-end analysis.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.executed: 7/7 archived input groups rerun; two fresh source-tip inputs executed

scientific_integrity.detail: All runtime claims cited in this audit were checked from the saved logs; measurements are explicitly local-storage observations rather than universal promises.

practice_boundaries.detail: This is a file-format utility and makes no clinical, diagnostic, or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: The revised table requires coordinate-plus-index input for Mutect2 and template-coordinate order for CallMolecularConsensusReads; both behaviors were executed.

code_usability.detail: The source-tip Python helper and shell pipeline were executed under samtools 1.24, pysam 0.24.1, bwa 0.7.19, GATK 4.6.2.0, and fgbio 4.1.1.

functional_suitability.note: Coordinate, name, tag, template-coordinate sorting, collate, merge, verification, and the fail-loud alignment pipeline are present and checked.

reliability.note: The example now validates threads and publishes only after count and index checks; an aligner may still report data-specific FASTQ parsing errors directly.

performance_context.note: Performance claims name their local-storage conditions and the detailed compression guidance is progressively disclosed in a reference.

agent_usability.note: Sort-order choices, verification, and failure remedies are explicit; advanced downstream tools marked dagger remain intentionally unverified locally.

human_usability.note: The description now exposes merge, collate, and order-verification triggers in natural user language.

security.note: No credentials or raw-code execution are present; file paths are quoted and the example rejects invalid thread counts.

maintainability.note: The 299-line SKILL.md has a focused performance reference, an executable example, and deterministic checks.

agent_specific.note: The trigger is precise, detailed material is referenced, reruns are safe, and error conditions are actionable.

inputs.label: Coordinate-sort, index, and CRAM conversion of shuffled real BAMs
inputs.note: Archived input 1 rerun: real 5,644-record BAM, 9,601-record 1000G BAM, and 15,788-record UMI BAM sort, preserve record multisets, and index; CRAM conversion and CSI creation succeed.

assertions.text: Coordinate sort preserves the input record multiset
assertions.note: The archived digest checks matched the original BAMs.

assertions.text: Sorted BAMs pass independent coordinate-order checks
assertions.note: pysam walk reported True for all three real sorted outputs.

assertions.text: Coordinate outputs are indexable
assertions.note: BAM BAI and CRAM CRAI creation succeeded.

assertions.text: Documented sort flags preserve records
assertions.note: -@, -m, -T, -l, and -O variants matched the default record stream.

inputs.label: Natural versus ASCII queryname order and duplicate marking
inputs.note: Archived input 2 rerun: -n and -N match natural and ASCII orders respectively; Picard accepts -N and rejects -n when the orders differ, while fixed-width names demonstrate the documented exception.

assertions.text: -n and -N produce distinct documented orders when names differ numerically
assertions.note: read2 precedes read10 for -n and read10 precedes read2 for -N.

assertions.text: -N matches Picard queryname order
assertions.note: The query-name streams compared equal.

assertions.text: The qualified Picard rule matches runtime behavior
assertions.note: Differing orders were rejected and coincident fixed-width orders were accepted.

assertions.text: Name grouping supports the documented duplicate and FASTQ workflows
assertions.note: Both sort modes and collate yielded 100 duplicate reads and paired FASTQ names.

inputs.label: Tag, template-coordinate, malformed, and mislabeled alignments
inputs.note: Archived input 3 rerun: tag and template-coordinate order behavior, index failures, corruption handling, memory floor, and deterministic threaded output all match the skill.

assertions.text: Tag and template-coordinate outputs have the documented headers
assertions.note: Both header checks passed.

assertions.text: Non-coordinate outputs are not falsely presented as indexable
assertions.note: samtools index refused them with the documented errors.

assertions.text: Record-level checking catches a lying SO header
assertions.note: The helper returned False and ensure_coordinate_sorted repaired the file.

assertions.text: Thread settings preserve the record stream
assertions.note: -@ 0, 4, and 8 streams matched.

inputs.label: Merge lanes, read groups, and name-sorted inputs
inputs.note: Archived input 4 rerun: merge detects no order itself, preserves valid coordinate input, documents RG collision risk, and -n/-N merges yield their corresponding order.

assertions.text: Merged valid inputs preserve record counts
assertions.note: 5,644 plus 500 records yielded 6,144 records.

assertions.text: Mismatched order is detected by the documented verification process
assertions.note: Merge exited zero but the independent order walk returned False.

assertions.text: RG collision warning is reproducible
assertions.note: -c collapsed distinct same-ID groups until IDs were made unique.

assertions.text: Name-sort merge flags provide correct order
assertions.note: -n and -N outputs passed natural and ASCII checks respectively.

inputs.label: Downstream matrix, storage conditions, and performance flags
inputs.note: All archived input-5 scripts reran. The downstream matrix, local versus network storage comparison, compression, existing-directory -T behavior, and fgbio/Mutect2 checks support the revised wording.

assertions.text: Existing-directory -T behavior is documented correctly
assertions.note: Temporary samtools files appeared inside the supplied directory and were cleaned up.

assertions.text: Performance text is conditioned on storage
assertions.note: Collate was fast on local ext4 and much slower with a network-mounted temporary prefix.

assertions.text: CMCR requires template-coordinate grouping
assertions.note: Coordinate and MI-tag sorts failed while GroupReadsByUmi template-coordinate output succeeded.

assertions.text: Mutect2 requires coordinate sorting and an index
assertions.note: Only coordinate-sorted indexed input completed.

inputs.label: Fresh source-tip uBAM and CRAM order verification
inputs.note: Fresh input 8 extracted the committed source-tip helper. It returned True for a sorted BAM and CRAM with explicit reference, and False for shuffled BAM and a no-@SQ uBAM.

assertions.text: uBAM returns False instead of raising
assertions.note: The no-@SQ uBAM returned False.

assertions.text: CRAM accepts an explicit reference
assertions.note: The real CRAM returned True with reference_filename.

assertions.text: Shuffled BAM is rejected
assertions.note: The helper returned False.

assertions.text: Clarified -T and -@ claims execute
assertions.note: An existing -T directory cleaned up and threaded streams matched.

inputs.label: Fresh source-tip pipeline failure and publication behavior
inputs.note: Fresh input 9 executed the committed pipeline with real FASTQs. Single-end threads work; invalid threads and unequal mates fail without replacing a valid output or leaving a partial temporary BAM.

assertions.text: Single-end invocation accepts a numeric thread argument
assertions.note: The four-argument single-end run completed and indexed.

assertions.text: Invalid thread values fail before output publication
assertions.note: abc was rejected and the valid output digest remained unchanged.

assertions.text: Unequal mate inputs do not overwrite a valid output
assertions.note: The primary-record check failed and the original digest remained unchanged.

assertions.text: Failure leaves no partial destination file
assertions.note: No keep.bam.partial process file remained.

key_strengths: The source-tip example validates arguments and publishes atomically after count and index checks.
The sort-order helper now distinguishes a no-@SQ uBAM from a coordinate-sorted BAM and supports explicit CRAM references.
Downstream order requirements for Picard, Mutect2, and fgbio are backed by executed checks.
Performance guidance names storage and data dependence instead of presenting one machine result as universal.
